about.title: About Me
about.statement: I listen to the business problem and build the solution.
about.description: I am a software engineer with 5 years spent shipping production systems: Python and FastAPI on the server, React and Next.js on the client, and the AWS infrastructure underneath. I work with small and medium businesses that need a process automated, a site live, or an application built to fit. I always write a proposal with scope and deadline before starting, so you know what you are agreeing to.

description: Built and maintain a generative AI-powered support system that helps answer customer questions.

Own the AWS cloud infrastructure behind these systems: Terraform (IaC), Docker and GitLab CI/CD.
Implemented authentication and application monitoring for the platform.
Developed and maintained the company's Python SDK, using pandas for data processing and Pytest for unit testing.
Built the interactive test suite in Playwright (Python and JavaScript) and load tests in Grafana K6.

Built a proof of concept for automatic test-case generation from software requirements, as a full-stack application in Node.js with IBM Watson, deployed to the cloud.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.statement: I collect as little as I can, and the Crudo app collects nothing at all.

who.heading: Who is responsible
who.body: This site and the Crudo app are made by Pedro Feiteira, an independent software engineer based in Portugal. For anything on this page, write to pedrofeiteira.dev@gmail.com.

site.heading: This website
site.body:
The only data this site receives is what you type into the contact form: your name, your email address and your message. It is delivered to my inbox through EmailJS, and I use it for one thing only — replying to you. I do not sell it, share it or add it to a mailing list.

This site runs no analytics, sets no tracking cookies and embeds no advertising networks.

apps.heading: The Crudo app
apps.body:
Crudo collects no personal data whatsoever. It works entirely offline and has no account system.

Everything you create in the app — your conversion history, favourites and any yield calibrations — is stored only on your own device, and is removed when you delete the app. None of it is sent to me or to anyone else.

Purchases are handled entirely by Apple. I never see your payment details, and Apple tells me only anonymous sales totals.

legal.heading: Legal basis and retention
legal.body:
Contact-form messages are processed on the basis of your consent, given when you choose to send the form, and kept only as long as the conversation needs them.

Because the app stores nothing off your device, there is no app data for me to retain, disclose or delete.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body:
Under the GDPR you may ask me for a copy of anything I hold about you, ask me to correct or erase it, or object to my using it. Write to pedrofeiteira.dev@gmail.com and I will respond.

If you believe I have handled your data badly, you may complain to the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD), Portugal's supervisory authority.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: If this policy changes, the revised version will appear on this page with a new date at the top.

support.title: Support
support.statement: Something not working, or a question about Crudo? Write to me directly.

contact.heading: Getting in touch
contact.body:
Email pedrofeiteira.dev@gmail.com, or use the contact form on this site. I read everything and usually reply within two working days.

If you are reporting a problem, telling me your device, your iOS version and what you were doing at the time will get you a useful answer much faster.

crudo.heading: About Crudo
crudo.body:
Crudo converts food weight between its raw and cooked states, by food and cooking method, so the number you log matches the number on your scale. The yield figures come from published USDA data.

It works with no network connection and needs no account.

purchases.heading: Purchases and restoring
purchases.body:
The full food database is a single one-time purchase — there is no subscription. If you have bought it before, on this device or another one, tap Restore Purchase on the paywall or in Settings and it will come back at no extra cost.

Refunds are handled by Apple rather than by me, at reportaproblem.apple.com.

data.heading: Your data
data.body:
Crudo keeps your history, favourites and calibrations on your device only. To erase all of it, delete the app.

There is no account to close and nothing stored on a server. See the privacy page for the full detail.
